coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with two advisories. Eleven attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject 855f2dee at 0444, 12315 bytes, unmoved and unedited; frozen v1 at c4b34cc5 and my v1 verdict at 3bd40e3e both agreeing with the dispatch and stable; HEAD never left 5d5d778; file 08 equal to the subject's own pin; required-now 26 of 26. Seven of seven cited digests reproduce. The fold lands completely and then goes further. I re-extracted actor-join v8's thirteen class entries this cycle and ran twenty-six equality comparisons: thirteen of thirteen definitionVerbatim strings are exact, and thirteen of thirteen v8EntryVerbatim strings — the whole id-plus-definition entry — are exact too. I checked the lengths against what I measured at v1, across the full range from the 32-character FC-JOIN-PERMISSIONREF-RESERVED to the 577-character FC-JOIN-COMPONENT-TAIL, because shortening the long one is how a repair like this quietly fails; none is short. I asked for one field per class and the candidate carries three: the whole entry, the isolated definition, and the v8 source path on every class. Carrying both the entry and the split lets a later reader verify the em-dash split rather than trust it, which is the check I had to run by hand. Nothing regressed: zero paths removed, the thirteen ids still ordered-equal to leftover-join v2's array, rideStanding still opening with its exact phrase, all thirteen bytes fields still NOT-AUTHORED, and the six 64-hex strings still all citations — so roughly 2,700 characters of added definition text introduced no digest and no fixture content. The G09 non-ride, the no-new-gate standing, the FC-C1 refusal and the BLK-1..4 outstanding entries are all untouched. Two advisories carry, one partly addressed: failsIf now exists where v1 had none, though it self-tests only the folded finding, and there is still no whatThisCloses block stating in one place that acceptance closes nothing by itself; and namedGate is still the bare 'none' where leftover-join v2 says 'none as authored implementations', with rideStanding carrying the fuller phrase. Neither is a reason to author a v3. This ACCEPT does not close OBL-JOIN-FX-AUTHORING; that additionally requires your recording. Worth noting for the record: this lineage's Claude 2 paths were free at both turns, so both my verdicts are filed. Five sibling doctor-fc catalogs reviewed immediately before this lineage remain unfiled because their Claude 2 paths were already occupied by verdicts I did not author and declined to overwrite.
